topic.source_contract: AQMA and receptor context, baseline monitoring, source emissions, dispersion method, mitigation, planning conditions, implementation and post-occupation verification evidence

scope_guards: An AQMA boundary is not treated as proof that every parcel breaches an objective.
A modelled concentration is not treated as a measured receptor result.
A planning mitigation proposal is not treated as installed or effective mitigation.
An air quality action plan is not treated as permission for a development.
A construction dust plan is not treated as verified operational air quality.
An emission factor is not treated as a site-specific monitored concentration.
A planning condition is not treated as discharged.
No score or promotion is written without exact receptors, inputs, method, consent, implementation and monitored outcome evidence.
